This is awesome. Beat it once then had to come back. Managed to beat it without any game audio. Its amazing this only took a week to make. I really hope you come back and give it a remake, rework some things and add more levels cause I absolutely need more. If I could make a suggestion, give us breakable walls, and the ability to through the rocks in at least 4 directions, preferably 8. Imagine having some shortcuts and corridors blocked by walls that you have to throw a rock at to get through. Plus it'd make the rock more useful cause once you get to the point where cobb can smell, I found the rocks useless cause he seems to not stun if I hit his head and he's already aggroed to me and if he's close enough to hear the rock sound and go to it, he'll catch my scent and aggro to me anyway.
